# Data matrix

This matrix documents the current local data contract. Provider setup, credentials required for connection, fetch windows, and integration restrictions stay in [INTEGRATIONS.md](INTEGRATIONS.md). Feature and interaction coverage stay in [FEATURE_MATRIX.md](FEATURE_MATRIX.md) and [CLICK_MATRIX.md](CLICK_MATRIX.md).

Generated from the reviewed data registry in [scripts/data-matrix.ts](../../scripts/data-matrix.ts), actual Entry field names/types in [shared/model.ts](../../shared/model.ts), and shared limits/provider names. Field/provider coverage and generated-file drift are checked by `npm run docs:check`. Behavioral descriptions are maintained registry metadata, not automatically inferred or proof of a live provider.

**Collected originals means normalized, bounded text and metadata.** Raw provider JSON, original MIME messages, complete linked articles, and image/attachment bytes are not archived. Filtering preserves the collected representation; it cannot recover content that was never fetched or was truncated during normalization.

Legacy receipts without frozen evidence require manual inspection. Source deletion removes drafts/credentials but retains metadata receipts, including acknowledgments of already transmitted requests. ## Collected entry fields

Types and optional markers below come directly from `Entry`. All entries share the normalization rules in [server/connectors.ts](../../server/connectors.ts); repeated ingestion/state preservation is in [shared/pipeline.ts](../../shared/pipeline.ts). String-unit bounds currently use JavaScript UTF-16 slicing; they are not word counts or visible-character budgets.

| Field | Type | Optional | Origin | Normalization / meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | No | Local UUID on normalization. | Repeated ingestion preserves the existing local ID. |
| `connectionId` | `string` | No | Owning connection ID. | Joins an item to its connection; the connection owns its feedIds links; items exist independently of feeds. |
| `externalId` | `string` | No | Provider ID, else raw source URL, else SHA-256 of normalized title/content/provider date. | Ingest identity is connectionId + externalId; fallback hashes are independent of source order when provider text/date are unchanged. |
| `editVersion` | `number` | Yes | Local edit revision | Nonnegative version for conflict detection; independent of ingestion and read/save changes. |
| `localEdit` | `{ title: string; content: string; updatedAt: string }` | Yes | Local title/body override | Optional presentation-only title/content and updatedAt. Originals remain the input to rules, mentions and AI; preserved on re-ingestion and included in protected backups. |
| `title` | `string` | No | Provider title; otherwise the first 120 body string units or Untitled. | Plain text; bounded to 300 UTF-16 string units. |
| `content` | `string` | No | Collected provider body or excerpt. | Plain text with paragraph breaks; bounded to 12,000 UTF-16 string units. Full remote documents are not archived. |
| `author` | `string` | No | Provider author, else connection name. | Plain text; bounded to 200 UTF-16 string units. |
| `url` | `string` | No | Provider link or constructed Bluesky post link. | HTTP/HTTPS only, without embedded credentials; invalid/missing links become an empty string. Source fetching has stricter public HTTPS guards. |
| `publishedAt` | `string` | No | Parsed provider date, else normalization time. | ISO timestamp used for ordering and retention; an invalid/missing date falls back to the current time. |
| `receivedAt` | `string` | No | Local normalization time. | ISO timestamp; first local receipt is preserved on repeated ingestion. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | No | Provider categories/tags or adapter labels. | First 12 tags, normalized to plain text; missing tags become an empty array. |
| `image` | `string` | Yes | RSS image enclosure or Mastodon preview image. | Safe URL only; an optional fallback when media has no attachments. Stores a URL, not image bytes. |
| `type` | `'article' \| 'post' \| 'chat' \| 'email'` | Yes | Adapter kind or explicit sample type. | article/post/chat/email; optional for older stores, where presentation infers it from the connection. |
| `authorHandle` | `string` | Yes | Social account handle or Rocket.Chat username. | Optional plain text; bounded to 200 UTF-16 string units. |
| `avatar` | `string` | Yes | Social author avatar URL. | Optional safe URL; no avatar file is stored locally. |
| `media` | `{ url: string; alt: string }[]` | Yes | Mastodon image attachments or Bluesky image embed. | Up to four safe image URLs with alt text bounded to 500 string units each. Other attachment types are not retained by these adapters. |
| `chat` | `{ channelId: string; channelName: string; threadId?: string }` | Yes | Rocket.Chat or sample room/thread metadata. | channelId, channelName, optional threadId; grouping is scoped to connection + channel + thread after filtering. Rocket.Chat channelName is the local connection name. |
| `contentWarning` | `string` | Yes | Mastodon spoiler_text, or Sensitive content when sensitive is true. | Optional plain text; bounded to 300 string units; reader hides body/media until reveal. |
| `saved` | `boolean` | No | Local bookmark flag, initially false. | Preserved on ingestion; saved entries survive the retention cutoff and remain available after feed-rule exclusion. Explicit deletion still removes them. |
| `read` | `boolean` | No | Local read flag, initially false. | Preserved on ingestion; user controls/article opening change it. IMAP Seen flags are left unchanged and are not imported as this flag. |

## Provider data to Entry mappings

These are the existing adapter mappings before common normalization. Missing provider titles use the shared title fallback; absent metadata remains optional. This section describes data only; connection setup and ingestion limits are in Integrations.

| Source | Entry type | Source fields → stored fields | Data boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RSS & Atom | article | `item.guid` → `externalId`; `item.title` → `title`; `item.contentSnippet \|\| item.content \|\| item.summary` → `content`; `item.creator \|\| feed.title` → `author`; `item.link` → `url`; `item.isoDate \|\| item.pubDate` → `publishedAt`; `item.categories` → `tags`; `image enclosure URL` → `image` | Feed-provided text may already be an excerpt. No linked-page scraping, enclosure downloads, author handle/avatar, chat metadata, or media array is collected. |
| Fediverse | post | `status.id` → `externalId`; `status.content` → `content`; `account.display_name \|\| account.acct` → `author`; `@ + account.acct` → `authorHandle`; `account.avatar_static` → `avatar`; `status.url` → `url`; `status.created_at` → `publishedAt`; `status.tags[].name` → `tags`; `first image preview_url` → `image`; `image attachments: url \|\| preview_url, description` → `media`; `spoiler_text \|\| sensitive fallback label` → `contentWarning` | HTML becomes plain text. Only image attachments are retained. A title is synthesized from collected text; this adapter does not collect reply/thread relationships, reactions, or boost metadata. |
| Bluesky | post | `post.uri` → `externalId`; `post.record.text` → `content`; `author.displayName \|\| author.handle` → `author`; `@ + author.handle` → `authorHandle`; `author.avatar` → `avatar`; `constructed bsky.app profile/post URL` → `url`; `record.createdAt` → `publishedAt`; `adapter label Bluesky` → `tags`; `embed.images: fullsize \|\| thumb, alt` → `media` | A title is synthesized from collected text. Image embeds are supported; reply/quote/repost relationships, reactions, facets, and non-image embeds are not stored. Hashtags are not extracted into tags. |
| YouTube videos | article | `playlistItem.contentDetails.videoId` → `externalId`; `playlistItem.snippet.title` → `title`; `playlistItem.snippet.description` → `content`; `playlistItem.snippet.channelTitle` → `author`; `@ + playlistItem.snippet.channelId when present` → `authorHandle`; `constructed youtube.com/watch video URL` → `url`; `playlistItem.snippet.publishedAt` → `publishedAt`; `largest supplied playlist thumbnail URL` → `image`; `adapter, parsed duration, explicit-playlist or candidate label` → `tags` | Public channel uploads or a user-selected public playlist only, using the user-owned YouTube Data API key. Up to three 50-item playlist pages and matching video-metadata batches per collection. Refresh reads the current first page before pending catch-up and commits the newest checkpoint only on completion; initial older pages require explicit history loading. No playback, downloads, transcripts, personalized/subscription/private data, or exact Shorts inference. Under-four-minute items are candidates only; an explicit Shorts-playlist label records user configuration, not provider verification. |
| Email | email | `mailbox UIDVALIDITY + message UID` → `externalId`; `mail.subject` → `title`; `mail.text` → `content`; `mail.from.text` → `author`; `mail.date` → `publishedAt`; `adapter label Email` → `tags` | Plain-text MIME body, including parser HTML-to-text conversion where available. No recipients, raw headers, message source, attachments, remote Seen state, or mailbox deletion state is retained. No source URL is supplied. |
| Rocket.Chat | chat | `message._id` → `externalId`; `message.msg` → `content`; `message.u.name \|\| message.u.username` → `author`; `message.u.username` → `authorHandle`; `message.ts` → `publishedAt`; `adapter label Team chat` → `tags`; `rid \|\| connection.roomId, connection.name, tmid` → `chat` | A title is synthesized from collected text. No message permalink, avatar, attachment, reaction, private-room/DM history, or complete conversation history is retained by this adapter. |
| API source | Configured post, article or email | `configured stable ID path` → `externalId`; `configured title path` → `title`; `configured body path` → `content`; `configured author path` → `author`; `configured date path` → `publishedAt`; `configured link path` → `url`; `optional image path` → `image`; `optional tags path` → `tags` | Read-only public HTTPS JSON GET. At most 100 items/page and three pages/operation. Mandatory stable IDs; absent date uses 1970-01-01, invalid supplied dates fail. Header credentials are encrypted; cursors cannot select another origin. No executable mapping, OAuth, inbound webhook or provider write. |
| Sample library | article, post, chat | `sample index or explicit fixture externalId` → `externalId`; `fixture.title` → `title`; `fixture.content` → `content`; `fixture.author` → `author`; `fixture.url when supplied` → `url`; `fixture.tags` → `tags`; `fixture.type or article default` → `type`; `fixture.authorHandle when supplied` → `authorHandle`; `fixture.chat when supplied` → `chat`; `current time minus fixture age` → `publishedAt` | All entries are fictional. Stable fixture IDs allow repeated ingestion; relative publication times are recalculated on sync. Sample checks do not verify a provider account. |

## Retention, filtering, and removal

| Operation | Current data behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Mention alerts | Derived from included decisions only, opt-in per feed with up to 20 explicit @handles. Whole text mentions are matched case-insensitively in title/body. Badge counts unread matches; summaries are 180-code-point excerpts. Old feeds default off/empty. No alert records, external delivery, provider notification API calls, or AI summaries. |
| Repeated ingestion | Match connectionId + externalId; refresh normalized provider fields, preserve local id, first receivedAt, saved, read, editVersion and localEdit. Missing upstream entries are not automatically removed. |
| Retention | Sort by publishedAt and retain the newest 300 entries of each connection plus any older saved entries. Provider checkpoints commit with successful merge; supported sources collect bounded older pages. Ordinary retention remains 300, so collected history is not unlimited. |
| Lens deduplication | Ordinary entries compare canonical URLs without tracking parameters/fragments, or lowercased title/content. Chat events use connection + provider event ID. Duplicate exclusion does not delete storage. |
| Filtering and Saved | Linked enabled sources → mute → include-any → deduplication; all decisions explain their result. Saved uses the saved flag even when the ordinary lens excludes an item, while reader filters still apply. |
| Context and reader search | Context matches unique words of at least three letters/numbers against title/content/tags/author. Reader search also checks handles and channel names. Neither operates on only the visible excerpt. |
| Display size | Per-feed current-default, word (1–5000) or grapheme-character (1–20000) limits affect previews only. Optional post/article-email/chat overrides inherit the feed limit. Full reading and originals stay accessible; media visibility/size, typography, width and conversation preview count are persisted separately. |
| Pause | Retain connection, encrypted credential, entries, and receipts; skip sync and ordinary feed inclusion. Paused connections still count toward the limit; saved entries remain accessible. |
| Disconnect or delete | Source disconnect removes its credential, entries including saved, and source receipts, and clears linked feed digests. Feed deletion removes links/digest/feed receipts but keeps sources/items. Unlinking retains all source data. In-flight source results are discarded if removed, paused, or toggled since collection started. |
| Persistence and backup | Clone state, increment revision, write a temporary JSON file, then rename atomically. Created data directory uses mode 0700 and files 0600. Preserve store.json with secret.key; unreadable/unsupported stores fail visibly. |
| Manual AI data flow | Only on explicit generation: send the configured model, feed context, and up to 20 included items containing numbered reference, title, content prefix of 2,000 string units, and author. Uses the configured key and store:false. This is separate from a reader display budget. |
| Remote media | Store validated URLs and alt text, not media bytes. Rendering loads images from their remote URLs; opening source links navigates externally. Mail/media attachments are not archived. |

## Maintaining this contract

Update `scripts/data-matrix.ts` when data mapping, normalization, retention, public summaries, or deletion behavior changes. Regenerate with `npm run docs:generate`; verify with `npm run docs:check` and the checks appropriate to changed code. Keep provider setup in Integrations, product backlog in the tracking lists/queue, and actual pass results in IMPLEMENTATION.
